notes: Draft configuration: Short course using the rounded eastern S bend and direct western straight. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 881.6 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 30 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: Original border rings cross or touch at the northern spur and follow a western return that differs from the retained direct-straight source configuration. Complete source-aligned measurements replace the pair while retaining the original trace and timing.

measurement.note: Sparse approximate image measurements for the retained draft source course using the direct western straight and rounded eastern S bend. Native normal-offset panels and complete boundary overlays were inspected. Additional southern grass-edge reads at245,250,255,260 and265 correct a rejected first-pass diagonal shortcut. Shared-paving sections200..220 and235..245 interpolate between visible edge endpoints; no direct boundary measurement is claimed at open junctions210 and240. The inner join235..245 is straight across visible shared pavement. Other sections also interpolate between sparse observations. Capture date and absolute georeferencing accuracy are unknown. This retained configuration and its limits are not operator-confirmed or surveyed.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
